qa_pairs.question: I paid for an order partly with a gift card and partly with my credit card. If I return it, how and when will I be refunded?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: After inspection, the refund is issued to the original payment methods within five to seven business days. The gift-card portion cannot be refunded as cash; it returns to a replacement gift card.

qa_pairs.question: I want to buy a USD 400 device (after discounts) with OrbitPay instalments. How is the payment split, can a gift card cover the first payment, and what happens if an instalment fails?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The purchase is eligible because it is at least USD 300 after discounts. The plan requires 25% at checkout (USD 100) and three equal monthly payments. Gift cards cannot fund the initial 25%. A failed instalment receives a seven-calendar-day retry period; continued failure may suspend the account from new instalment purchases but does not remotely disable the device.

contexts.text: OrbitPay instalments are available for eligible device purchases of at least USD 300 after discounts. The plan requires 25% at checkout and three equal monthly payments. Gift cards cannot fund the initial 25%.

qa_pairs.question: My package has stopped moving in tracking. When is it considered delayed, and when can I get a refund or replacement?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A package is considered delayed when it has no tracking update for three business days beyond the latest estimated delivery date; support may then open a carrier trace. No refund or replacement is issued while the trace is within its five-business-day investigation period. If the carrier confirms loss, OrbitTech offers either a replacement, subject to stock, or a refund to the original payment methods.

contexts.text: A package is considered delayed when it has no tracking update for three business days beyond the latest estimated delivery date. At that point, support may open a carrier trace. A refund or replacement is not issued while an active trace is within its five-business-day investigation period.
If a carrier confirms loss, OrbitTech offers either a replacement, subject to stock, or a refund to the original payment methods.

qa_pairs.question: How long does a covered repair usually take once the service centre has my device, and what happens if a part is not available?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Initial diagnosis normally takes up to three business days after the service centre receives the product, and a covered repair normally takes up to ten additional business days when parts are available. These periods exclude shipping time and time waiting for customer approval. If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy.

contexts.text: Initial diagnosis normally takes up to three business days after the service centre receives the product. A covered repair normally takes up to ten additional business days when parts are available. These periods exclude shipping time and time waiting for customer approval. If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy.

qa_pairs.question: Can I use two percentage-off promo codes on one order, or combine a percentage code with my OrbitPlus accessory discount?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. Only one percentage-off promotional code may be applied to an order; it may be combined with a gift card but not with another percentage code or a clearance markdown. The OrbitPlus accessory discount cannot stack with a percentage-off code; checkout applies the larger eligible discount.

contexts.text: Only one percentage-off promotional code may be applied to an order. A percentage code may be combined with a gift card, but not with another percentage code or a clearance markdown.
OrbitPlus accessory discounts cannot stack with a percentage-off code; checkout applies the larger eligible discount.

qa_pairs.question: I think someone hacked my OrbitTech account and placed an order. What should I do, and can the order be stopped?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security. If the unauthorized order is still Confirmed, attempt cancellation from the account page. If it is already packing or dispatched, Account Security coordinates with the Payments and Delivery teams, but cancellation or interception is not guaranteed.

contexts.text: A customer who suspects account compromise should reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security.
If it is already packing or dispatched, Account Security coordinates with the Payments and Delivery teams; cancellation or interception is not guaranteed.
An order can be cancelled from the account page while its status is `Confirmed`.

qa_pairs.question: I placed my order on August 25, 2026, it was delivered on September 3, and I opened the device. Can I still return it on September 12?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. Return Policy version 1.0 applies because the order was placed before September 1, 2026; the order-placement date decides the version, while return days are counted from confirmed delivery. Version 1.0 allows only seven calendar days for opened devices, so the window ended on September 10, and opened-device returns under that version carried a 15% restocking fee.

contexts.text: For return-policy eligibility, the triggering event is the order-placement date, while the number of return days is counted from confirmed delivery.

Return Policy version 1.0 applies to orders placed before September 1, 2026. It allowed 21 calendar days for unopened devices, seven calendar days for opened devices, and charged a 15% opened-device restocking fee.

qa_pairs.question: My OrbitPlus membership was active when I ordered a PulsePhone X on September 5, 2026. It is still unopened 40 days after delivery. Can I return it, and would the answer change if I had opened it?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Yes. The order falls under Return Policy version 2.0, and because OrbitPlus was active on the order date, the unopened-device window is extended from 30 to 45 calendar days, so day 40 is within the window. If the phone had been opened, OrbitPlus would not help: the opened-device window stays at 14 days with a 10% restocking fee, so it could not be returned on day 40.

contexts.text: OrbitPlus extends the unopened-device return window from 30 to 45 calendar days for eligible purchases made while membership is active. It does not extend the 14-day opened-device window, override hygiene exclusions, or extend a product warranty.
For version 2.0 orders, the extension applies only when OrbitPlus was active on the order date.
An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee.

qa_pairs.question: I dropped my PulsePhone X and cracked it, then bought OrbitPlus the next day. Can I get it fixed under warranty, and what will it cost if I decline the repair quote?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. Accidental impact is excluded from the warranty, and buying OrbitPlus after the incident does not turn accidental damage into a warranty claim. The damage may still be repairable for a fee: OrbitTech sends a written quote valid for seven calendar days. If the customer declines, a USD 35 diagnostic fee applies unless remote support confirmed before shipment that no diagnostic fee would be charged.

contexts.text: The warranty excludes loss, theft, cosmetic wear, depleted consumables, accidental impact, liquid exposure, electrical damage from an unsupported charger, unauthorized modification, and repair by a non-authorized provider.
Accidental damage may still be repairable for a fee, but it is not converted into a warranty claim by purchasing OrbitPlus after the incident.

For an out-of-warranty or excluded issue, OrbitTech sends a written quote. The quote remains valid for seven calendar days. Work begins only after approval and required payment. If the customer declines, a diagnostic fee of USD 35 applies unless remote support confirmed before shipment that no diagnostic fee would be charged.

qa_pairs.question: A covered part in my NovaBook 14 was replaced 22 months after delivery. How long is the new part covered, and would a full replacement device have started a new 24-month warranty?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The replacement part is covered for the longer of 90 calendar days or the remainder of the original warranty. Since the 24-month warranty began on delivery, only about two months remain, so the part is covered for 90 calendar days. A replacement device would not restart a new 24-month warranty.

contexts.text: Coverage begins on confirmed delivery for shipped orders and on collection for store-pickup orders.
Replacement parts are covered for the longer of 90 calendar days or the remainder of the original warranty. A replacement device does not restart a new 24-month warranty.

qa_pairs.question: I ordered a USD 1,200 NovaBook 14 with standard shipping to a designated remote area. How long should delivery take after dispatch, and can the carrier leave it at my door if I am out?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Standard shipping normally takes three to five business days after dispatch, plus two additional business days for a designated remote area, so about five to seven business days; weekends and carrier holidays do not count, and these are estimates, not guarantees. Because the device is valued above USD 1,000, an adult signature is required and OrbitTech does not authorize the carrier to leave it unattended. After the first failed attempt, the customer may request carrier pickup, but the carrier may require identification matching the shipment name.

contexts.text: Standard domestic shipping normally arrives in three to five business days after dispatch.
These are service estimates, not guarantees. Orders to designated remote areas require two additional business days. Weekends and public carrier holidays are not business days.

Orders containing devices valued above USD 1,000 require an adult signature. A customer may request carrier pickup after the first failed delivery attempt, but the carrier may require identification matching the shipment name. OrbitTech does not authorize a carrier to leave a signature-required package unattended.

An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days with a 10% restocking fee, so an opened NovaBook 14 cannot be returned on day 40.
